aboutPage.title: A Different Kind Of Record Label.
aboutPage.subtitle: Independent in spirit. Artist-first by design. Built for what comes next.
aboutPage.intro: Quantum Frequency Records is an independent record label and creative platform built around the belief that great music does not need to fit a predetermined lane.
aboutPage.mission: Discover distinctive voices. Give artists the freedom and support to develop their sound. Build partnerships that respect ownership, transparency and long-term creative ambition.
aboutPage.approach: We use thoughtful systems, modern tools and efficient infrastructure to keep the focus on the music. The goal is to make the business simpler, not make the creative process smaller.
aboutPage.ai: Music technology can open new creative possibilities. Where AI tools are used in the creation or development of a release, that context should be documented accurately and transparently in the release information.
aboutPage.closingQuote: Every artist has a frequency. Our job is to help the world hear it.
